name: CopyExcelWorksheetNode
label: Copy Excel Worksheet
description: Copies a worksheet to another workbook or within the same workbook, preserving data, formatting, and structure.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: SourceWorkbook
fields.label: Source Workbook
fields.description: The Excel Workbook object containing the worksheet to copy.

fields.name: CopyMode
fields.label: Copy Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to identify the worksheet to copy (by Name or by Index).

selectOptions.label: Name
selectOptions.description: Copies the worksheet by its name.

selectOptions.label: Index
selectOptions.description: Copies the worksheet by its index.

fields.name: WorksheetName
fields.label: Worksheet Name
fields.description: The name of the worksheet to copy (required if 'Copy Mode' is 'Name').

fields.name: WorksheetIndex
fields.label: Worksheet Index
fields.description: The index of the worksheet to copy (required if 'Copy Mode' is 'Index').

fields.name: TargetWorkbook
fields.label: Target Workbook
fields.description: The Excel Workbook where the worksheet will be copied. If not provided, the copy will be made within the same workbook.

fields.name: PastePosition
fields.label: Paste Position
fields.description: Specifies where to paste the copied worksheet in the target workbook.

selectOptions.label: First worksheet
selectOptions.description: Pastes the worksheet as the first sheet in the target workbook.

selectOptions.label: Last worksheet
selectOptions.description: Pastes the worksheet as the last sheet in the target workbook.

fields.name: CopiedWorksheet
fields.label: Copied Worksheet
fields.description: The new worksheet created as a result of the copy operation.
